user.title: Connect to Matter Hub
user.description:
Using the Matter Hub app on this Home Assistant (Alpha app for now): in the app's Configuration tab, turn on Allow local access, optionally set a Local API password, and restart the app. Then leave the URL blank, and enter that password if you set one; the user name hamh is filled in.

Matter Hub in Docker or on another computer: enter its address, such as {example_url} (port 8482 unless you changed it).

Installing Matter Hub: {project_url}.

data_description.username: Leave blank for the app (hamh is used when you enter a password). For Docker, the username set in Matter Hub, if any.
data_description.password: The app's Local API password if you set one, or the password set in Matter Hub.

init.title: Enter the Matter Hub address
init.description:
Matter Bridge no longer reaches {title} through a Home Assistant ingress session, so the integration is not loaded. Ingress sessions belong to a logged-in user, and an integration cannot create one.

Connect it again to keep using this same integration. Its devices, entity names and automations stay.

Using the Matter Hub app on this Home Assistant (Alpha app for now): in the app's Configuration tab, turn on Allow local access, optionally set a Local API password, and restart the app. Then leave the URL blank, and enter that password if you set one; the user name hamh is filled in.

Matter Hub in Docker or on another computer: enter its address, such as {example_url} (port 8482 unless you changed it).

Leave the username and password blank to keep ones already saved. See {project_url}.
